verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud documents streaming metrics through an OpenMetrics endpoint into Datadog, Grafana Cloud, New Relic, Elastic and Prometheus. Separate worker-performance docs cover metrics and Task Queue information, so the export half of the story is supported. The evidence does not name failure-rate, latency or queue-depth metrics specifically, and shows no first-party alerting. Alerts would have to be built in the external observability stack. missing for 10: explicit documentation of failure-rate, latency and queue-depth metrics, native or documented alerting on workflow misbehavior, self-hosted metrics export evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, failure rates, latencies, and queue depths export to my observability stack, and alerts fire when workflows misbehave

citations.quote: stream metrics into Datadog, Elastic, Grafana Cloud, New Relic, ClickStack, or self-hosted Prometheus in about 5 minutes
